pages.text: A laptop or tablet can hide what a player types.

When a program calls INPUT with $(1)PARAMETER hide TRUE ;$(), the input line shows a $(1)*$() for every character. The typed line appears on the screen as $(1)***$(). Use it for passwords and keys. The value goes to the program as it was typed.
$(1)VARIABLE password STRING$(br)CALL INPUT$(br)  PARAMETER variable password ;$(br)  PARAMETER hide TRUE ;$()
